alarm.screen.description: Press the button below to cycle through the different types of alarms available. When you've found the one you want, click the 'Done' button at the bottom. Supply a redstone pulse (on/off signal) to any side of the box to sound the alarm.
alarm.screen.name: Alarm %s
manual.assortedtech.chapter.alarm.alarm:
An alarm sounds while it has power, and goes on any face of a block. Right click it to pick which of the sounds it makes.

Wired to a sensor it becomes a doorbell, or something considerably less polite.
manual.assortedtech.description: Laser bridges, gravity, sensors, spikes and additional redstone fun.
